scene_target: Introduce the UI glitch that locks Artie into the 1 HP / 100% Crit build.
goal: Artie attempts to allocate his stats safely.
conflict: A system glitch overrides Artie's choices and locks him into an extreme glass-cannon build.
end_condition: Artie is stuck with a glass-cannon build.
transition_in_text: Artie examines the stat allocation menu Fizz just opened for him.
transition_out_text: The system finalizes the glitched build, preparing to teleport Artie.

set.reason: System glitch locked stats to 1 HP and 100% Crit Rate, consuming all stat points.

persona_updates: Artie is terrified of his new fragility, realizing that with only 1 HP, anything could kill him.
Fizz is alarmed by the system anomaly and unable to override the glitch affecting Artie's build.

chapter_so_far_add: During character creation, a system glitch overrode Artie's choices, locking his stats into an extreme glass-cannon build with only 1 HP and a 100% Critical Hit Rate.
key_events: Artie began allocating his 10 available stat points into Vitality.
The stat allocation menu glitched and flashed an Anomaly Integrity Breach error.
The system locked Artie's Vitality to 0.1, setting his Max HP to 1.
To compensate for the deficit, the system set Artie's Critical Hit Rate to 100%.
The system finalized the glitched build and prepared to teleport Artie.
last_scene: Artie attempted to allocate his stat points to increase his health.
A system error occurred, jamming the interface and overriding his selections.
The glitch locked Artie's stats to a maximum of 1 HP and a 100% Critical Hit Rate, finalizing his build against his will.
